ayahs.text: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

tr.sahih: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
tr.pickthall: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,

ayahs.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

tr.sahih: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.

ayahs.text: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

tr.sahih: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
tr.pickthall: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!

ayahs.text: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

tr.sahih: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
tr.pickthall: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.

ayahs.text: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ

tr.sahih: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
tr.pickthall: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.

ayahs.text: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ

tr.sahih: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
tr.pickthall: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.

ayahs.text: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ

tr.sahih: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
tr.pickthall: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.

ayahs.text: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

tr.sahih: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
tr.pickthall: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.

ayahs.text: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

tr.sahih: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
tr.pickthall: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ

tr.sahih: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
tr.pickthall: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!

ayahs.text: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

tr.sahih: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
tr.pickthall: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,

ayahs.text: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

tr.sahih: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
tr.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.

ayahs.text: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

tr.sahih: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
tr.pickthall: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,

ayahs.text: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

tr.sahih: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
tr.pickthall: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.

ayahs.text: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
tr.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).

ayahs.text: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,

ayahs.text: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
tr.pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.

ayahs.text: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

tr.sahih: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
tr.pickthall: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

ayahs.text: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

tr.sahih: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
tr.pickthall: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;

ayahs.text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
tr.pickthall: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ

tr.sahih: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
tr.pickthall: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩

tr.sahih: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.

ayahs.text: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

tr.sahih: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr.pickthall: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.

ayahs.text: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

words.gloss: for it will lead you astray

tr.sahih: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
tr.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
tr.pickthall: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!

ayahs.text: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ

tr.sahih: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
tr.pickthall: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?

ayahs.text: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

tr.sahih: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
tr.pickthall: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.

ayahs.text: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).

ayahs.text: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

tr.sahih: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
tr.pickthall: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

ayahs.text: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ

tr.sahih: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
tr.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.

ayahs.text: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

tr.sahih: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
tr.pickthall: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

tr.sahih: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
tr.pickthall: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.

ayahs.text: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

tr.sahih: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
tr.pickthall: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.

ayahs.text: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

tr.sahih: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
tr.pickthall: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),

ayahs.text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

tr.sahih: And others bound together in irons.
tr.pickthall: And others linked together in chains,

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

tr.sahih: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
tr.pickthall: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr.pickthall: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.

ayahs.text: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

tr.sahih: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
tr.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.

ayahs.text: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

words.gloss: (is a spring of) water to bathe

tr.sahih: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
tr.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.

ayahs.text: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

tr.sahih: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.

ayahs.text: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
tr.pickthall: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).

ayahs.text: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ

tr.sahih: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
tr.pickthall: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

tr.sahih: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
tr.pickthall: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.

ayahs.text: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

tr.sahih: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
tr.pickthall: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

tr.sahih: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
tr.pickthall: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,

ayahs.text: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

tr.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
tr.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,

ayahs.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

tr.sahih: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
tr.pickthall: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.

ayahs.text: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

tr.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
tr.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
tr.pickthall: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
tr.pickthall: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ

tr.sahih: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
tr.pickthall: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,

ayahs.text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

tr.sahih: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
tr.pickthall: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

tr.sahih: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
tr.pickthall: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,

ayahs.text: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

tr.sahih: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
tr.pickthall: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!

ayahs.text: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
tr.pickthall: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
tr.pickthall: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
tr.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!

ayahs.text: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

tr.sahih: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
tr.pickthall: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?

ayahs.text: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ

tr.sahih: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
tr.pickthall: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
tr.pickthall: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.

ayahs.text: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,

ayahs.text: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.

ayahs.text: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Say, "It is great news
tr.pickthall: Say: It is tremendous tidings

ayahs.text: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: From which you turn away.
tr.pickthall: Whence ye turn away!

ayahs.text: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

tr.sahih: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
tr.pickthall: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;

ayahs.text: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
tr.pickthall: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.

ayahs.text: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

tr.sahih: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
tr.pickthall: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
tr.pickthall: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,

ayahs.text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr.pickthall: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,

ayahs.text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.

ayahs.text: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
tr.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ

tr.sahih: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
tr.pickthall: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
tr.pickthall: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

ayahs.text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

tr.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr.pickthall: Until the day of the time appointed.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
tr.pickthall: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,

ayahs.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr.pickthall: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

tr.sahih: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
tr.pickthall: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,

ayahs.text: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
tr.pickthall: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.

ayahs.text: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.

ayahs.text: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

ayahs.text: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

tr.sahih: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
tr.pickthall: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
